# Review Campaign

## Purpose

Plan or synthesize a root-orchestrated audit campaign across multiple supplied review packages.

## Preconditions

Use explicit workflow approval. The repository set and case Results and artifacts are supplied by the root, with no direct network need.

## Inputs

Use campaign criteria, supplied review cases, evidence and Claim inventories, repository and artifact snapshots, limits, and checks.

## Procedure

Define a coverage matrix, compare case findings, identify systemic contradiction, provenance, and reproducibility failures, and prioritize root-side remediation and follow-up cases.

## Outputs

Return exactly one strict Result with campaign-level assurance and gaps plus one pending Proposal with supported remediation or a root-side follow-up plan.

## Checks and Stop Conditions

Stop on an incomplete repository set, inconsistent audit criteria, missing case provenance, a limit breach, or any request to launch or repair work directly.

## Authority Boundaries

Do not traverse repositories beyond supplied artifacts, create Dispatches, mutate canonical statuses or Claims, decide Proposals, commit Git history, or expand scope.
